name: EU AI Act
description: EU AI Act overlay for high-risk AI systems. Activated by AI training data or biometric data declarations.

PR-01.regulatory_citation: EU AI Act Art. 16 - Obligations of providers of high-risk AI systems

DE-01.regulatory_citation: EU AI Act Art. 9(2) - Risk management, ongoing monitoring

notes: EU AI Act requires risk classification, human oversight for high-risk systems, transparency, and extensive record-keeping. Biometric identification systems are classified as high-risk. This overlay enforces strict monitoring and human oversight requirements.
